pages.text: Pongi's fringe covered her eyes. It kept getting in the way.
"Just a little trim." Pongi showed how little with her fingers.
Dad brought some scissors. "I'll do it for you."
Dad cut the other side too. This time, that side was even shorter.
Dad cut again. Pongi's fringe was now above her eyebrows.
Pongi looked in the mirror. Her fringe looked like a staircase.
Mom opened the door. Then she took the scissors from Dad.
Mom trimmed Pongi's fringe neatly. Now her eyes were clear to see.
Dad quietly sat in the chair. Mom held the scissors to Dad's hair.
